# Cratis Studio

> Cratis Studio is a collaborative workspace where developers, domain experts and product owners design business behavior together with event models, screens and specifications.

Key facts:

- Studio is a hosted product at https://app.cratis.studio; sign-up and pricing are at https://cratis.studio.
- Boards hold event models: commands, events, read models, screens and Given/When/Then specifications.
- Studio edits Cratis Screenplay models and is built on Cratis Chronicle; framework documentation lives at https://www.cratis.io.

## Documentation Sets

- [Abridged documentation](https://docs.cratis.studio/llms-small.txt): a compact version of the documentation for Cratis Studio, with non-essential content removed
- [Complete documentation](https://docs.cratis.studio/llms-full.txt): the full documentation for Cratis Studio

## Notes

- The complete documentation includes all content from the official documentation
- The content is automatically generated from the same source as the official documentation
